text: Yettoore woodanii Alla, taguɗo kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin, no ɗi anndiranooka, waɗuɗo e Malaa'ika'en nulaaɓe siinooɓe yamaruyeeji Makko: hino e maɓɓe yottinooɓe wahayu on e Annabaaɓe ɓen, O semmbiniri ɓe nden hoolaare nde O halfini ɓe tottugol, woɗɓe ɓen ko marɓe gabitanji ɗiɗi e ɗi tati e ɗi nayi, hiɓe wiirira ɗi hunnugol ko Alla yamiri ɓe. Kanko Alla, himo ɓeyda ko O muuyi e tagu Makko ngun, immorde e tergal maa ŋari maa hito, tawde pellet, Alla ko hattanɗo kala huunde, huunde ronkintaa Mo.
